WITH album_stats AS (
  SELECT
    AlbumId,
    CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(Milliseconds), 0) AS ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY AlbumId
),
average_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM album_stats
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    s.AlbumId,
    s.ratio,
    s.track_count,
    s.ratio - a.avg_ratio AS ratio_diff
  FROM album_stats AS s
  CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a
  WHERE s.ratio > a.avg_ratio
)
SELECT
  AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio,
  AVG(track_count) AS avg_track_count,
  AVG(ratio_diff) AS avg_ratio_diff
FROM qualifying
